external_collaboration.evidence_quote: To evaluate its educational impact, 42 partnered with the French Ministry of National Education on a scientific study conducted by an independent research team. Carried out during the 2023–2024 school year, the study found a positive impact on pupils’ confidence in their ability to learn programming, as well as improvements in the classroom environment and social interactions, including a reduction in negative emotions and bullying.
